# GitHub Action: Collect CI reports

<!-- header:end -->
<!-- badges:start -->

[![Marketplace](https://img.shields.io/badge/Marketplace-collect--ci--reports-blue?logo=github-actions)](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/collect-ci-reports)

<!-- badges:end -->
<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Parse native reports, publish summaries and retain selected files in one artifact. Internal helper for lint and test.

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- usage:start -->

## Usage

```yaml
- uses: hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-python/.github/actions/retain-reports@b76a2704ad4ad5508679a7bf1aeb1cd8ef9c176e # fix/enforce-lint-checks
  with:
    # Validated absolute project directory.
    # This input is required.
    directory: ""

    # Report paths or auto selectors passed to the common parser.
    # Default: `auto:test`
    report-paths: auto:test

    # Calling job ID used to group reports.
    # This input is required.
    group: ""

    # Title of the GitHub report summary.
    # Default: `CI reports`
    report-name: CI reports
```

<!-- usage:end -->
<!-- inputs:start -->

## Inputs

| **Input**          | **Description**                                             | **Required** | **Default**  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------ |
| **`directory`**    | Validated absolute project directory.                       | **true**     | -            |
| **`report-paths`** | Report paths or auto selectors passed to the common parser. | **false**    | `auto:test`  |
| **`group`**        | Calling job ID used to group reports.                       | **true**     | -            |
| **`report-name`**  | Title of the GitHub report summary.                         | **false**    | `CI reports` |

<!-- inputs:end -->
